expectations.evidence: ExecutionStrategy trait. Four impls: ShellCommand, HttpRequest, DockerRun, ClosureTask. Trait-based.
Each strategy holds its own config fields. Clean separation.

Scheduler works with Box<dyn ExecutionStrategy>. HOWEVER: retry logic is embedded directly in run_task() function inside the scheduler, not separated as a composable concern. This means retry behavior can't be applied selectively or composed with other wrappers.
Adding new executor = new struct + impl. Scheduler untouched. Retry/timeout are in the scheduler loop, so they apply uniformly but can't be customized per-executor.
